description: Despite the soaring prices of memory components that have ultimately increased smartphone rates, gaming smartphones are still pretty accessible to the masses. There are several options in the sub-Rs. 40,000 segment that offer powerful chipsets, high-refresh-rate displays, and dedicated cooling systems. This means you do not necessarily need to spend flagship-level money for a phone capable of handling demanding games. Phones like the Redmi Turbo 5 with its Dimensity 8500 Ultra chipset and 3D Ice-Loop cooling, as well as the Oppo K13 Turbo Pro with its built-in fan, put a strong emphasis on sustained performance.
title: Best Gaming Phones Under Rs. 40,000: Redmi Turbo 5, Oppo K13 Turbo, Poco F7 and More

description: WhatsApp has a built-in tool to free up storage space on your smartphone without deleting any of your chats. The app on both iOS and Android offers a storage manager that lets you select and delete large files, such as forwards or duplicates, to free up space. The tool provides a clear visual breakdown of which media items (in their respective chats) are taking up space.
title: How to Free Up WhatsApp Storage Without Deleting Chats: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Here are the best phones for video recording in India right now. Our recommendations include the iPhone 17 Pro Max, Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, Google Pixel 10 Pro XL, Vivo X300 Ultra, and Xiaomi 17 Ultra. The Vivo X300 Ultra has two 200-megapixel sensors, while the Xiaomi 17 Ultra has a 200-megapixel telephoto camera.
title: Best Phones for Video Recording in India: iPhone 17 Pro Max, Galaxy S26 Ultra, and More

description: Portrait photography on smartphones has become more versatile, with flagship models offering dedicated telephoto cameras, large sensors and software tools designed for people shots. From Google's Pixel 11 Pro and Xiaomi's Leica-tuned 17 Ultra to the Vivo X300 Ultra, Galaxy S26 Ultra and iPhone 17 Pro Max, these phones take different approaches to portraits. Here is a look at their camera hardware, key specifications and prices in India to help you choose the right phone for your photography needs.
title: Best Phones for Portrait Photography in India in 2026: Pixel 11 Pro, Vivo X300 Ultra, More

description: The compact smartphone segment has received several entries in 2026. This is great news for those who prefer a smaller phone but do not want to compromise too much on performance. While most manufacturers continue to favour large displays, phones such as the iPhone 17, Samsung Galaxy S26 and Google Pixel 11 retain relatively compact form factors while offering high-end processors and capable operating systems. The Vivo X300 FE and Oppo Reno 15 Pro Mini 5G also join the category with promising cameras and fast charging.
title: Best Compact Smartphones in India: iPhone 17, Google Pixel 11, Vivo X300 FE and More

description: The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max sit at the top of Apple's smartphone range, but buyers have several Android options in the same premium segment. Google's Pixel 11 Pro series focuses on Google's Tensor platform and software features, while Samsung, Vivo, Oppo and Xiaomi offer flagship models with high-resolution cameras and large batteries. This comparison covers the key specifications, features, configurations and India prices of five alternatives, helping readers evaluate other premium smartphones before choosing Apple's latest Pro models.
title: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max Alternatives: Pixel 11 Pro to Xiaomi 17 Ultra and More

description: Google lets Android phone users safely factory reset their handset via two methods. You can either enter recovery mode to factory reset your device or go to the system settings menu to do the same. A complete factory reset deletes all the apps, locally saved files, system settings, photos, videos, and messages from your handset. It comes in handy if you have been facing various software-related issues or performance-related issues. On top of this, you must also factory reset your phone before selling it.
title: How to Factory Reset an Android Phone Safely: A Step-by-Step Guide
